channel.title: ThyBlackman – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from ThyBlackman – Bias and Credibility (thyblackman.com)

item.title: Black Women’s History Month Tribute: Mayor Johnny Ford Honors Black Women’s Legacy.
item.description: A powerful Women’s History Month tribute highlighting Black women’s sacrifices, leadership, and historic contributions through a resolution shared by former Tuskegee Mayor Johnny Ford.

item.title: Dogecoin and NFTs: A Match Made in Meme Heaven?
item.description: Dogecoin and NFTs may seem unrelated, but both are driven by meme culture, online communities, and digital creativity. Here is how DOGE and NFTs are starting to connect.

item.title: SAVE America Act, Voter ID, and Black Voters: Election Integrity Debate in America.
item.description: A political commentary on the SAVE America Act, voter ID laws, election integrity, illegal immigration, and the political debate surrounding Black voters and federal elections in America.

item.title: Book Review; Legendborn: An Unapologetic Coming of Age.
item.description: Tracy Deonn’s Legendborn is a powerful YA fantasy that blends grief, Black identity, ancestral magic, and legacy through the unforgettable journey of Bree Matthews.

item.title: The Myth of the Disappearing Black Woman from the Workforce.
item.description: A look at Black women in the federal workforce, government downsizing, and why some argue the issue is being framed through race and gender politics instead of numbers and fiscal reality.

item.title: When the Factory Closed: The Painful Decline of Working Class America.
item.description: From Maine to Virginia, shuttered factories left behind joblessness, addiction, violence, and despair. A look at how deindustrialization wounded America and why the nation needs a new industrial plan.

item.title: History Shows Empires Fall From Overreach. Is America Heading Down the Same Path?
item.description: History shows that empires rarely fall suddenly but decline slowly through war, debt, and internal division. Is America facing the same fate as past empires?

item.title: Bill Cosby Civil Trial Loss Raises Questions About Justice, Race, and Celebrity Accountability.
item.description: Bill Cosby faces another major civil trial loss as debates continue over race, celebrity justice, legal accountability, and whether Cosby is a victim or a victimizer.

item.title: The Man Who Rigged the Rulebook: How Denmark Groover Invented the Runoff.
item.description: The SAVE Act echoes an old voter suppression playbook tied to Denmark Groover’s Georgia runoff law, raising fresh concerns about barriers to voting for minorities, women, the elderly, and rural Americans.

item.title: 8 TLC Songs You Should Listen To Before The It’s Iconic Tour.
item.description: A look at 8 TLC songs one should check out including No Scrubs, Waterfalls, Creep, Diggin On You and more as TLC prepares for the It’s Iconic tour with Salt-N-Pepa and En Vogue.

item.title: Rapper Afroman Police Raid Lawsuit Becomes Free Speech Victory.
item.description: Rapper Afroman won a lawsuit filed by Ohio deputies after he used security footage from a police raid in parody music videos. The case raised major First Amendment and free speech issues.

item.title: Black Leaders Continue To Fail The Black Community.
item.description: An analysis of liberalism, the Democrat Party, and the Black community in America, arguing that old political strategies are failing in a modern digital world and new approaches are needed.

item.title: “No Kings” Protests Spread Beyond Big Cities as Economic Frustration Grows Across America.
item.description: Millions of Americans joined No Kings protests across the country, reflecting growing frustration over economic inequality, government spending priorities, and the direction of the political system.

item.title: Debate Over Anti-DEI Policies and Military Promotions Sparks Fairness Concerns.
item.description: Debate grows over anti-DEI policies, fairness, and military promotions as concerns rise about meritocracy, diversity, and leadership decisions in the U.S. military.

item.title: Black Americans Could Be Disproportionately Harmed by SAVE Act.
item.description: The SAVE America Act is being criticized as a modern voter suppression bill that could disenfranchise millions, especially Black Americans, through strict citizenship rules and voter roll purges.
